newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends steady on U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends steady on U.S. holiday.

text.p: 1430 GMT - The Swiss franc ended little changed in routine trading with U.S. markets closed for a holiday, dealers said.
The franc gave ground against the dollar and mark as some traders adjusted some positions before the weekend, but it ended off its lows after moving in narrow ranges.

Dealers said the Swiss National Bank appeared content with current levels for the franc and interest rates. "I don't think they want to raise rates. That would be deadly with the economy just slowly picking up speed," one dealer said.

* Dollar ends at 1.4668/4678 francs, up a bit from 1.4660/4670 at the opening and from yesterday's close at 1.4644/4654 * Mark closes at 83.64/67 Swiss centimes, a tad lower than the previous close at 83.75/77 and the opening 83.72/75 * KOF economic barometer rises 0.1 percent in May, keeping prospects for a slight Swiss economic pickup from the second half intact
